name: Segments
description: Named dynamic filters of records, usable as the in_saved_filter filter condition

page.title: Segments
page.description: Segments are named saved filters. Members are calculated on the fly, respecting what you can see.
page.emptyDescription: Create a segment to track a group of records that match a filter.
page.noAccessDescription: You are not allowed to view people, organizations or deals.

person.title: No contact segments
person.description: Group contacts by a rule, such as "customers in São Paulo" or "leads without a reply for 7 days". The group updates itself.

organization.title: No company segments
organization.description: Group companies by a rule, such as "in healthcare" or "no recent contact". The group updates itself.

deal.title: No deal segments
deal.description: Group deals by a rule, such as "above $10k" or "stalled for 30 days". The group updates itself.

dialog.description: Name the segment and define the conditions records must meet.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameTaken: A segment with this name already exists.
dialog.filterHint: The segment is recalculated every time it is used.
dialog.filterRequired: Add at least one complete condition.
dialog.filterInvalid: The conditions are invalid. Review the fields and values.

detail.emptyDescription: No records visible to you meet this segment's conditions.
detail.invalid: This segment's filter is no longer valid. Edit the segment to fix it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete segment
deleteDialog.description: The segment "{{name}}" will be deleted. Records are not affected.
